name: Qlippoth-Corrupted Creature (CR +varies)
body:
Qlippoth corruption can have unpredictable and deadly effects upon creatures, with their enhanced psionic abilities disrupting established patterns on every level. Beyond the alterations made to many humanoids on Vandara, other lifeforms are similarly distorted, creating a wide variety of creatures with bizarre psionic abilities. Mages and scholars have been attempting for decades to find a cure for this affliction, but no such treatment seems within reach. Vandara has grown exponentially more dangerous since the qlippoth arrived, and that danger looks to escalate further with every infection.

Not all view the qlippoth corruption as a blight, and many refer to affected beings as “ascended” or “realized” rather than corrupted.

Qlippoth-corrupted is an acquired and inherited template that can be added to any non-outsider living creature (hereafter referred to as the base creature). The creature retains all the base creature’s statistics and special abilities except as noted here.

Challenge Rating: HD 4 or less, as base creature +1; HD 5 to 10, as base creature +2; HD 11 or more, as base creature +3.

Armor Class: A qlippoth-corrupted creature’s natural armor bonus improves by +2.

Attacks: All of a qlippoth-corrupted creature’s natural attacks spread lesser qlippoth corruption on each successful hit. The save DC of the disease is 10 + half the qlippoth-corrupted creature’s Hit Dice + the creature’s Charisma modifier.

Lesser Qlippoth Corruption: natural attack—injury; save Fort DC varies; onset 1 day; frequency 1/day; effect 1d6 Wis and 1d6 Cha Damage; cure 1 save.

Senses: A qlippoth-corrupted creature gains darkvision out to 60 feet.

Defensive Abilities: A qlippoth-corrupted creature gains resist 10 to acid, cold, and electricity in addition to power resistance equal to 11 + its new CR. The creature may lower or restore this power resistance as a standard action. A qlippoth-corrupted creature is immune to mind-affecting effects.

Psi-Like Abilities (Sp)

A qlippoth-corrupted creature possesses the psi-like abilities indicated below, depending on its Hit Dice. The abilities are cumulative. Unless otherwise noted, an ability is usable once per day. Manifester level is equal to the creature’s HD. The save DCs for a qlippoth-corrupted creature’s psi-like abilities are Charisma-based.

The qlippoth-corrupted creature may augment these abilities any way they wish.

3/day—defensive precognition, synesthete 3–4
3/day—control light, mind thrust 5–6
1/day—expose weakness, feat leech 7–8
1/day—dispel psionics, phantasmagoria 9–10
3/day—fold space,
1/day—malefic metamorphosis 11–12
1/day—sensory cascade 13–14
1/day—fuse flesh 15–16
3/day—greater psychoport 17–18
1/day—matter manipulation 19–20
1/day—assimilate

Abilities: +2 Con, –2 Wis (minimum 1), +4 Cha.

Table: Qlippoth-corrupted Psi-like
